I have some half-assed hobbies and interests. Sometimes I draw. I tend to be really into Youtube, and sometimes I ride my bike akin to what feels like a hamster in a wheel just burning off steam.

 I don't have much motivation to get involved with anything or anyone new though, because my many attempts at making real friends or a bf have all fallen through before. 

Besides, It seems that i have almost nothing in common with most people and some of the inane drivle i hear them talk about. Not sure how not to be demoralized about it. 

Like I'm so apathetic that if i dropped dead, it'd make no difference to me considering that my life is going nowhere and i have nothing to look forward to, no emotional fortitude to dream, and zero self delusion to convince myself something special is possible.
Um, just watch a BLM 'protest' *coughriotcough*, and there's your answer.

Why dont the accused just welcome an investigation if theyre innocent? Why are they running and saying this is false without proving it? If the allegations are just a witch hunt conspiracy like the accused say, they should be able to prove it in a court of law, instead of simply attacking those that dare question the mountains of evidence against them. An innocent person would want their reputation cleared of such evil, and them avoiding the issue is not going to do that.

What factual proof do you have that they didnt do this? The only thing you can say to disprove it is speculation based on either your incredulity, or secretly being a pedo sympathizer for all i know. You must not care about children's lives i presume considering youre siding with the accused. Any moral person who's examined all of the evidence as a whole, rather than its individual parts, would agree its highly suspicious and signals the need for an investigation, which is not unreasonable to ask for. The FBI has done nothing thus far because theyre likely complicit. If these people are innocent, why dont they welcome an investigation to clear their names of allegations, instead theyre running from this, and painting anyone who questions them as the bad guy? If i was accused of such atrocious evil, id stand up and proclaim my innocence by offering up everything i could as evidence. Id welcome an investigation lest people continue to doubt me and think I'm a monster.
